- Added Phigros chapter 9 noise fields with animation, subtraction areas, touch effects and audio filtering in Preview, Playtest and video export.
- Added a mobile Noise Field editor with per-field timelines, an overview of overlapping fields, RGB colors and immediate changes through Undo/Redo.
- Improved Phira-Pro noise-field export compatibility, color exchange, animation precision and recovery of earlier PhiStudio packages.
- Added independent shader/noise-field switches beneath the editing grid and Phira-style note sizing from 0.800 to 1.200.
- Added note-source selection in Preview: tap to select the owning judge line, hold/hover for details, and use Edit note to open the exact note in the grid.
- Fixed Micrology Playtest white flashes and unwanted pauses when pressing phone volume buttons.
- Accelerated local project scanning and opening.
- Organized Java production code and tests into feature packages, preserving the launcher component and existing Activity preferences.
